name: Brad
title: Testimonial Brad
context: Family construction business specialising in new builds, extensions, loft conversions and refurbishments
summary: Consistent marketing, a clearer management hierarchy and job-level cost tracking helped Brad streamline the family construction business.

name: Bradley Wheaton
title: Bradley Wheaton- Case Study
summary: Bradley reports changing how he approached marketing and architects, then moving turnover from £440,000 towards a target of at least £800,000.

caseStudy.headline: Bradley Wheaton: £440,000 towards at least £800,000
caseStudy.starting: Bradley does not come from a construction background. He was paying for leads on sites such as Rated People and Bark and says it was easy to overspend.
caseStudy.changed: He describes automating marketing and going directly to architects.
caseStudy.after: On target for at least £800,000 the following year (target at filming)
caseStudy.timeframe: About one year (second year to the following year's target).
caseStudy.quote: I wouldn't be where I am with this business now, if you wasn't coaching me along the way, that's for sure.

name: Dale Marshall
title: Dale Marshall - Case Study
summary: Dale says a focus on marketing, architect outreach, accountability and clearer business systems helped him almost double turnover.

name: Dan Burke
title: Testimonial Dan Burke
context: Construction business run with three cousins
summary: Dan reports that rebranding, improving the website and generating Google reviews helped move turnover from £470,000 towards a £700,000 to £800,000 projection.

caseStudy.headline: Dan Burke: £470,000 towards £700,000 to £800,000
caseStudy.starting: Dan runs the business with his three cousins, all of whom were on the tools, and says none of them were businessmen.
caseStudy.changed: They rebranded, made changes to the website and started collecting Google reviews, which Dan says has already brought in leads.
caseStudy.after: Projected £700,000 to £800,000 this year (forecast at filming)
caseStudy.timeframe: Six months into the programme at the time of filming.
caseStudy.quote: So that's just two things that we've implemented and it's made a big difference already.

name: Dave Darby
title: Testimonial Dave Darby
summary: Dave says lead generation was a major catalyst as turnover moved from £150,000 to £635,000 and later headed towards £1 million.

caseStudy.headline: Dave Darby: £150,000 to £635,000 turnover
caseStudy.starting: Dave says the business had been running for about ten years, four of them "a complete uphill struggle". Turnover in 2022 was £150,000.
caseStudy.changed: Greg set a £500,000 target. Dave describes lead generation as the major catalyst, then a focus on building out systems to cope with fast growth.
caseStudy.after: £635,000 turnover the following year, then "just shy of a 1,000,000" (forecast at filming)
caseStudy.timeframe: About 12 months for the first step. The near-£1 million figure was a forecast at the time of filming.
caseStudy.quote: We smashed that, did 635,000. In turnover, not profit.

name: Geoff Walker
title: Testimonial Geoff Walker
summary: Geoff says coaching and community support helped him solve business problems as he doubled turnover in two consecutive years.

caseStudy.headline: Geoff Walker, Refuse Limited: turnover doubled two years running
caseStudy.starting: Geoff runs Refuse Limited, a commercial interiors business. He says that most of what the programme covers did not exist in his business before.
caseStudy.changed: He describes using the full programme, plus the community for problems he previously would not have known how to solve.
caseStudy.after: Turnover doubled in each of two consecutive years
caseStudy.quote: if doubling my turnover over the last two consecutive years is anything to go by, then I think it's very much worth it.

name: Dominic Marchant
title: Dominic Marchant - Case Study
summary: Dominic set clear targets, improved his financial position and promoted a labourer into a site manager role.

name: George
title: Testimonial George
summary: A defined callback process, qualification questions and a structured quote helped George systemise sales and protect his time.

name: James Overton
title: Testimonial James Overton
context: Residential design and build business with a property development arm
summary: James reports growing annual revenue from about £1.5 million to £2 million and later forecasting £4 million while adding property development to the group.

name: James Wilcock
title: Testimonial James Wilcock
summary: Reading Greg's book, joining the Mastermind community and gaining a clear business plan helped James move beyond being stuck on the tools and uncertain about pricing.

name: Lukas
title: Lukas - Case Study
summary: Lukas reports shifting from roughly £100,000 to £150,000 jobs towards a £250,000 minimum threshold while improving his work-life balance.

name: Mike and Nick
title: Mike and Nick - Case Study
context: Tradesmen running a kitchens and extensions business
summary: Mike and Nick report that after building the team and strengthening systems and back-office processes, monthly turnover moved from about £35,000 to roughly £80,000.

caseStudy.headline: Mike and Nick: about £35,000 to about £80,000 a month
caseStudy.starting: Mike and Nick were turning over roughly £35,000 a month, with the two of them and a labourer, and little back-office structure.
caseStudy.changed: They describe putting systems and processes in place, job tracking with the apps, growing the extensions side, opening a showroom and bringing in a designer.
caseStudy.before: About £35,000 a month; Mike, Nick and a labourer
caseStudy.after: About £80,000 a month; eight people around them plus subcontractors
caseStudy.quote: Everyone needs a coach in life.

name: Richard Abrahams
title: Richard Abrahams - Case Study
summary: Richard frames coaching as an investment in guidance, accountability and stronger foundations for business growth.

name: Richard
title: Testimonial Richard
summary: Richard reports that systems, delegation and professional branding freed more time as turnover moved from about £750,000 to £1.1 million.

caseStudy.headline: Richard: about £750,000 to about £1.1 million turnover
caseStudy.starting: Richard says the business was "becoming a bit stale" and he was bogged down in day-to-day firefighting.
caseStudy.changed: He describes more efficient systems, delegating his responsibilities and a full rebrand: website, marketing material, vehicles and staff uniforms.
caseStudy.after: About £1.1 million turnover, with the next goal set on gross and net profit
caseStudy.quote: We found it absolutely invaluable for our business

name: Stephen and Salina
title: Stephen and Salina - Case Study
summary: Stephen and Salina report that stronger operating systems helped move turnover from about £870,000 towards a £1.4 million projection.

caseStudy.headline: Stephen and Salina: about £870,000 towards £1.4 million
caseStudy.starting: Stephen and Salina say that coming out of lockdown they had very little in place on the operating-systems side.
caseStudy.changed: They describe a big improvement in operating systems and tracking the growth of the business month on month.
caseStudy.after: On track for about £1.4 million (forecast at filming)
caseStudy.quote: It's a lot, it's a lot of work, but it's, it's good work.

name: Valy Stan
title: Valy Stan - Case Study
summary: Processes and delegation helped Valy reduce his operational workload, free more personal time and build a less stressful business.

name: Will

summary: Will recounts reaching £1.5 million turnover with roughly 2% profitability, effectively break-even, before adding office support, systems and project-level financial tracking.

name: Marek
title: Develop Coaching Client Testimonial - Marek
summary: Marek reports turnover of just over £1 million before joining, then doubling within a year, alongside improvements to operations, marketing and the use of AI.

caseStudy.headline: Marek: turnover doubled in a year from just over £1 million
caseStudy.starting: Marek says the business was turning over "perhaps around just over a million" before joining.
caseStudy.changed: He points to operations, how the company presents itself on social media and other platforms, and rolling out AI across the company.
caseStudy.after: Turnover doubled within a year. After a difficult year across construction, he expects the best year so far (forecast at filming).
caseStudy.timeframe: About one year for the doubling.
caseStudy.quote: Since we joined Greg and his team, effectively our turnover doubled in the space of a year.

name: Robert McGill
